overlap.tooltip: Number of overlapping frames between source and new images

overlap_mode.tooltip: Method to use for overlapping frames

new_images.tooltip: The new images to extend with

crop.tooltip: 0 will do the default center crop, this is a workaround for the widget order changing with the new frontend, as in old workflows the value of this widget becomes 0 automatically

megapixels.tooltip: Target megapixels (1.0 = 1 million pixels). Use 0 to skip resize and keep the original size.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: Target aspect ratio. 'default' keeps original ratio.

keep_proportion.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio change when not using 'default'.

divisible_by.tooltip: Width and height will be divisible by this value.

default_divisible.tooltip: When enabled, ensures final output dimensions strictly follow divisible_by constraint.

mask_channel.tooltip: Channel to use for the mask output

background_color.tooltip: Fills the alpha channel with the specified color.

columns.tooltip: The number of columns in the grid.

rows.tooltip: The number of rows in the grid. Set to 0 for automatic calculation.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

output_folder.tooltip: The folder to save the images to.

caption_file_extension.tooltip: The extension for the caption file.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

output_folder.tooltip: The folder to save the images to.

file_extension.tooltip: The extension for the caption file.

border_blending.tooltip: Blur the mask edges in the bounding box

bg_color.tooltip: Color as RGB values in range 0-255, separated by commas.

color.tooltip: Color as RGB values in range 0-255, separated by commas.
Color as RGB values in range 0-255 or 0.0-1.0, separated by commas.

number_digits.tooltip: 编号位数，如设置为3则为001格式
编号位数，如设置为3则为001格式

quality.tooltip: JPEG/WebP 质量。数值越高体积通常越大、保存通常越慢。

png_compress_level.tooltip: PNG 压缩等级。Replicate 场景建议保持较低数值以减少保存耗时。

optimize.tooltip: 启用 Pillow optimize。主要影响 JPEG/TIFF。若编码器报错，节点会自动回退到不使用 optimize。

webp_lossless.tooltip: 启用无损 WebP。通常会更慢且文件更大。

webp_method.tooltip: WebP 编码方法。越高通常压得更小，但更慢。Replicate 场景建议使用 0-2。

image.tooltip: Input RGB image from Load Image or any IMAGE node.

mask.tooltip: MASK from Load Image. ComfyUI stores alpha as 1 - alpha in this mask.

image.tooltip: Processed IMAGE output, usually after passing through RGB-only nodes.

alpha.tooltip: Original alpha returned by RGBA Safe Pre.

has_alpha.tooltip: Boolean flag returned by RGBA Safe Pre. False makes this node act as passthrough.

epsilon.tooltip: Minimum alpha used during unpremultiply to avoid divide-by-zero and bright edge artifacts.

image.tooltip: RGB image to save as PNG. Use RGBA Safe Post first if the image is still premultiplied.

alpha.tooltip: Alpha mask to embed into the saved PNG.

filename_prefix.tooltip: Filename prefix for the saved PNG files.

image.tooltip: Processed image. If it comes from RGBA Safe Pre, it is usually still premultiplied.

alpha.tooltip: Alpha from RGBA Safe Pre. It will be resized automatically to the current image size.

has_alpha.tooltip: Boolean flag from RGBA Safe Pre. Used by auto mode to decide whether alpha should be kept.

file_format.tooltip: Output file format. JPEG never keeps alpha. PNG and WebP can keep alpha.

alpha_mode.tooltip: auto: keep alpha only for PNG/WebP when has_alpha is true. keep: force alpha-capable save. flatten: composite over background color and save RGB only.

epsilon.tooltip: Only used when alpha is kept. Prevents divide-by-zero and overbright edges during unpremultiply.

background_red.tooltip: Background red channel used when flattening alpha to RGB.

background_green.tooltip: Background green channel used when flattening alpha to RGB.

background_blue.tooltip: Background blue channel used when flattening alpha to RGB.

jpeg_quality.tooltip: JPEG encoder quality. Higher values keep more detail and larger files.

webp_quality.tooltip: WebP quality used in lossy mode.

webp_lossless.tooltip: Enable lossless WebP encoding. Usually larger but preserves pixels better.

png_compress_level.tooltip: PNG compression level. Higher values reduce size but may save slower.

sage_attention.tooltip: Patch the model attention override to use SageAttention. Choose disabled to remove an existing SageAttention override.

allow_compile.tooltip: Allow torch.compile inside the SageAttention wrapper when the backend supports it.

block_size.tooltip: Size of blocks in pixels (smaller = smaller blocks)
